parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set protocols cfm.explanation: 启用连接故障管理（CFM）协议。

set protocols cfm ma ma1 mep 3 interface.template: set protocols cfm ma [parameter1] mep [parameter2] interface [parameter3]
set protocols cfm ma ma1 mep 3 interface.command: set protocols cfm ma ma1 mep 3 interface ge-0/0/1.1
set protocols cfm ma ma1 mep 3 interface.explanation: 配置CFM维护端点（MEP）及其关联的接口。

set protocols cfm ma ma1 mep 3 ccm-send.template: set protocols cfm ma [parameter1] mep [parameter2] ccm-send
set protocols cfm ma ma1 mep 3 ccm-send.command: set protocols cfm ma ma1 mep 3 ccm-send
set protocols cfm ma ma1 mep 3 ccm-send.explanation: 配置MEP发送连续性检查消息（CCM）。

set protocols cfm ma ma1 mep 3 remote-me.template: set protocols cfm ma [parameter1] mep [parameter2] remote-mep [parameter3]
set protocols cfm ma ma1 mep 3 remote-me.command: set protocols cfm ma ma1 mep 3 remote-mep 4

set protocols cfm ma ma1 mep 3 test-id 2.template: set protocols cfm ma [parameter1] mep [parameter2] test-id [parameter3] remote-mep [parameter4]
set protocols cfm ma ma1 mep 3 test-id 2.command: set protocols cfm ma ma1 mep 3 test-id 2 remote-mep 4
set protocols cfm ma ma1 mep 3 test-id 2.explanation: 配置MEP的测试ID及其关联的远端维护端点。

set protocols cfm ma ma1 mep 3 loss-meas.template: set protocols cfm ma [parameter1] mep [parameter2] loss-measurement [parameter3]
set protocols cfm ma ma1 mep 3 loss-meas.command: set protocols cfm ma ma1 mep 3 loss-measurement single-ended

set protocols cfm ma ma1 mep 3 loss-meas.template: set protocols cfm ma [parameter1] mep [parameter2] loss-measurement interval [parameter3]
set protocols cfm ma ma1 mep 3 loss-meas.command: set protocols cfm ma ma1 mep 3 loss-measurement interval 30000
set protocols cfm ma ma1 mep 3 loss-meas.explanation: 配置MEP丢失测量的间隔时间。

parameters.name: interval
parameters.explanation: 测量间隔时间，单位为毫秒。

set routing-instances evpna instance-typ.explanation: 配置路由实例的类型为虚拟路由器。

parameters.name: instance-type
parameters.explanation: 路由实例的类型，例如虚拟路由器。

set routing-instances evpna route-distin.explanation: 配置路由实例的路由区分器。

parameters.name: route-distinguisher
parameters.explanation: 路由区分器，用于唯一标识路由实例中的路由。

set routing-instances evpna vrf-import v.explanation: 配置路由实例的VRF导入策略。

parameters.name: vrf-import
parameters.explanation: VRF导入策略，用于控制哪些路由被导入到VRF中。

set routing-instances evpna vrf-export v.explanation: 配置路由实例的VRF导出策略。

parameters.name: vrf-export
parameters.explanation: VRF导出策略，用于控制哪些路由从VRF中导出。

set routing-instances evpna bridge-domai.explanation: 配置路由实例的桥接域。

set interfaces ge-0/0/1.1 unit 0 family.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family ethernet-switching vlan-id [parameter3]
set interfaces ge-0/0/1.1 unit 0 family.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/1.1 unit 0 family ethernet-switching vlan-id 2

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ge-0/0/1.1 unit 0 family.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family ethernet-switching interface-mode [parameter3]
set interfaces ge-0/0/1.1 unit 0 family.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/1.1 unit 0 family ethernet-switching interface-mode access
set interfaces ge-0/0/1.1 unit 0 family.explanation: 配置接口的模式为接入模式。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

parameters.name: interface-mode
parameters.explanation: 接口模式，例如接入模式。

set interfaces ge-0/0/1.1 unit 0 family.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family ethernet-switching bridge-domain [parameter3]
set interfaces ge-0/0/1.1 unit 0 family.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/1.1 unit 0 family ethernet-switching bridge-domain 10

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。
